title: Controls
content:
# Controls

# Introduction

These are default controls for Valheim. In the settings menu, keyboard keys can be reassigned, and certain options can be adjusted for controllers.

• Action: Move around | Default Key: WASD | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Left Stick

• Action: Look around | Default Key: Move mouse | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Right Stick

• Action: Fire | Default Key: LMB | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Right Trigger

• Action: Block | Default Key: RMB | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Left Trigger

• Action: Jump | Default Key: Space | Steam/Xbox Controllers: B Button

• Action: Run | Default Key: Left shift | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Left Bumper

• Action: Barrel roll | Default Key: RMB + Space / WASD | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Left Trigger + B Button

• Action: Interact (use, pickup etc.) | Default Key: E | Steam/Xbox Controllers: A Button

• Action: Use Hotbar Slot Item | Default Key: 1–8 | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Dpad Up (Dpad Left or right to switch)

• Action: Open inventory | Default Key: I / Tab | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Y Button

• Action: Move in Inventory Area | Default Key: Move Mouse | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Left/Right Bumper

• Action: Split Stack | Default Key: Shift + Left Click | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Left Trigger + A Button

• Action: Move/Drop Stack | Default Key: Ctrl + Left Click | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Right Trigger + A Button

• Action: Repair Tools | Default Key: Click Button at Bench | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Right Stick down in Crafting Area

• Action: Toggle minimap | Default Key: M (, and . to zoom mini) | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Menu/Select Button

• Action: Zoom map | Default Key: Mouse Wheel | Steam/Xbox Controllers: In mini map Left/Right Trigger

• Action: Move map | Default Key: Left Click and Drag | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Left Stick

• Action: Select map marker | Default Key: Left Click | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Dpad Up/Down

• Action: Place map markers | Default Key: Double Left Click | Steam/Xbox Controllers: A Button

• Action: Remove map markers | Default Key: Right Click | Steam/Xbox Controllers: B Button

• Action: Toggle map markers | Default Key: Left Click on Marker | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Dpad Right on marker you want to toggle

• Action: Zoom camera in | Default Key: Mouse scroll up

• Action: Zoom camera out | Default Key: Mouse scroll down

• Action: Toggle chat box | Default Key: Enter

• Action: Submit | Default Key: Enter

• Action: Cancel | Default Key: Escape

• Action: Screenshot | Default Key: F12

• Action: Hide HUD | Default Key: Ctrl + F3

• Action: Auto Walk | Default Key: Q

• Action: Sit | Default Key: X | Steam/Xbox Controllers: X Button

• Action: Sneak | Default Key: Left ctrl | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Left Stick Click

• Action: Secondary Attack | Default Key: Middle Mouse Button | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Right Bumper

• Action: Boss Power | Default Key: F | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Dpad Down

• Action: Settings/Exit Menu | Default Key: Esc | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Start/Menu Button

• Action: Toggle Hide/Show Weapon/Shield | Default Key: R | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Right Stick Click

• Action: Toggle Building Snap Placement | Default Key: Shift | Steam/Xbox Controllers: Left Bumper

• Action: Open emote wheel | Default Key: T

Categorias: User interface
